title: thin context stops

setup.note: The same compare, but the dates are not in the action's inputs and the budget arrived at 0.4 confidence. Nothing is fetched and no call is made: the run asks once, combined.

spaces.label: Goa trip with Rohan in December

script.note: A full compare script the run must never reach — the thin check fires first.

input_events: One prepared action of kind compare whose dates are missing and whose budget is doubted.

expected.note: ONE combined card naming every gap; the doubted value is prefilled and marked confirm?, never written as a value.
